_comment: THE ONLY FIXTURE IN THIS DIRECTORY THAT WAS NOT RECORDED FROM THE LIVE API,
and it is here because the failures it describes cannot be recorded on demand:
in 433 real entries across six routes and four months, every single one was
well-formed and carried actual=true. That is exactly why the parser's
defences need a fixture of their own — untested defences are decoration.
One good row and seven bad ones. App\Infrastructure\Pricing\
TravelpayoutsPriceProvider must return precisely the good one.
Travelpayouts ignores unknown keys, so this leading _comment is inert: the
adapter reads `data`, and a fixture that explains itself beats a README
nobody opens next to a file of numbers.
data: a bare string where an object belongs
